title: Renju, Free Play, two stones: the round trip on a placement board
why: The whole session round trip under a game whose plies place rather than move. It pins that a session created for a placement game is store-attached like any other — created, committed per ply, resumed from its row and encoded to the bytes that row holds — under the frozen empty 15x15 start its own game names. A core that carried the movement games' start position, move grammar or rules_id would pass every xiangqi scenario unchanged and fail here.
